normal_source: retain UNCERT normals; zero-tangent loc_extra patches read the exact owning prior surface normal from the stage-1 source table; no GT or nearest-surface substitution
coordinate: EPSG:25832 minus [690953, 5336071, 604] m; registered stage-1 patch centres

edge.negative_distance: retain -0.25 m at edge cells, as specified

missing.mvs: no MVS term when p_M or u_M missing, or u_M <= 0
missing.als_prior: independent medians of sigma_prior and v_prior_now from known u_prior in same unit; exclude scoring
missing.outside_uncert: LoD2 prior from geometry, MVS sigma/V unit medians; ALS all four unit medians; oracle uses now; exclude scoring

gates.coverage_numerator: prior sigma and stratum from rule without missing-ALS/outside-UNCERT median fallback
gates.lod2_denominator: whole-scene nearest pairs within 1 cm; each of three units
gates.mvs: distribution only; not a stop gate

legacy_connections: 5 cm and 18 cm records remain historical; unused for training or scoring
